title: Psoriatic Arthritis Screening
subtitle: Dermatology visit triggers for rheumatology referral

steps.prompt: Psoriasis patient with joint pain, morning stiffness, heel pain, dactylitis, or swollen joints?
Inflammatory pattern: morning stiffness >30 min, improves with activity, swelling, dactylitis?
High-risk features: nail psoriasis, scalp/inverse disease, severe skin disease, family history?
Low threshold rheumatology referral or validated screen

citations.quote: AAD-NPF psoriasis guidelines include comorbid disease screening and management considerations.
Elmets CA et al. Joint AAD-NPF guidelines of care for psoriasis with awareness and attention to comorbidities. J Am Acad Dermatol. 2019.
